pages.text: A relay totem extends the flight area by one chunk. Place it in a chunk next to one that is already covered, up to five chunks from the Core.$(br2)Each relay belongs to the first Core it connects to, so nobody can borrow your chain.

pages.name: Relay Totem
pages.text: Plinth, Column, then a $(item)Relay Crown$() on top. Right-click the crown to see whether it is connected.
